subject: May 6 exec update — wins, blockers, QBR action items
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: May 6 exec update — wins, blockers, QBR action items

Team —

Quick weekly pulse ahead of next week’s QBR prep. High-level bullets (details + slides attached):

Wins:
- Hosted API: 12% improvement in p95 tail latency after the 2-node kernel tweak; customer-facing dashboards reflect the change.
- Closed: ACME Cloud pilot contract signed (see note below) — legal and procurement cleared terms.
- CS: Two expansion trials converted to paid in EMEA; on track to hit bookings target for quota quarter.

Risks / Blockers:
- Capacity: Dedicated pools are showing 85–92% utilization during peak windows (US evenings). If next-week spike materializes, throughput could degrade for lower-tier routes.
- QBR readiness: Need final slide deck and a short exec summary for the board pack by Monday EOD.
- Security questionnaire: ACME requested additional audit logs (SOC2 artifact); SecOps will need scoped evidence by Tue.

Asks (action owners in parentheses):
- Ops: Run a short capacity soak with burst policy enabled and report delta by EOD Mon (Jonas).
- Product/Eng: Confirm fallback routing thresholds and owner for emergency rollback (Markus).
- Legal/RevOps: Confirm ACME signature timeline + finalize SOW addendum (Vivek).
- Enablement: Finalize the 2-slide customer impact summary for the board (Laura + Maya).

Attachments: QBR_prep_apr-to-may_v2.pptx, Ops-heatmap-may.csv
Related links: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/ops/latency-heatmap, JIRA-RED-1123

I’ll consolidate owners and send a short follow-up tomorrow with timeboxed check-ins.

Thanks —
Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

---
Note: ACME point of contact is Tara Singh (tara@acmecloud.com); procurement indicated they can sign the addendum once we confirm retention SLA in writing.

Thanks Monica — good summary. Quick Q: for the capacity soak, can you include the per-tier error budget projection (p99 errors) and the customer-impact mapping for the two largest accounts?

If Ops can surface that on the dashboard link you shared, that should be sufficient for the board slide. I can help tighten the customer impact slides with Maya.

Laura

Thanks all — quick follow-up with owners and next steps: 

1) Capacity soak: Jonas will run the soak today with burst policy enabled and share p95/p99 projections + per-tier error-budget impact by 11:59pm PDT (Jonas). Link to the console will be posted in the drive link.

2) Provisioning run: Jonas + Karthik will test provisioning of the two pre-staged low-cost GPU instances and report cost/time delta in the Ops CSV (attachment). If provision time >30m, we will trigger routing to quantized variant as temporary fallback (Markus to confirm rollback steps).

3) QBR pack: Laura + Maya to finalize the 2-slide customer impact summary by Mon EOD, I’ll merge into the deck and circulate for sign-off.

4) SOC2 artifact: Vivek to coordinate with SecOps and Legal; expect scoped evidence by Tue. I’ve looped in ACME contact (Tara) via separate thread for signature timing.

I’ll run a quick 20-minute sync Monday 10:30am PT to confirm sign-offs and any last-minute edits — calendar invite sent.

Appreciate the quick turn here.

Best,
Monica
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
